messages:
zoe: Alert from monitoring eu-west ingress 5xx surge. Deploybot auto-paused the 21:00 slot. Can we confirm hold + short mitigation?

deploy-bot: [automated] paused release slot 2026-05-12T21:00Z due to service.edge 5xx rate > threshold. Paused window: 21:00-21:30.

ian: Confirming hold. Recommend DO_NOT_REQUEUE for 21:00, pin canary to v4.3.0 (last-known-good), and schedule a tentative micro-stagger at 23:30 with 3m cadence.

kevin: I see the runtime flag `adaptive-batch` enabled in last rollout; edge pods show queue growth when CPU > 80%. Suggest disabling it on canaries now.
sre-oncall: Applying canary-only patch: `kubectl patch cm edge-runtime -n infra -p '{"data":{"adaptive-batch":"off"}}'` and restarting canary pods. ETA ~7m.

io n: (typo)

ian: Pinning slot: `releasectl pin --slot 21:00 --version v4.3.0 --reason "incident hold - ingress 5xx"` and flagging DO_NOT_REQUEUE.

kevin: Patch applied; canary pods restarted. Early signal: 5xx down ~50% on canaries within 4m. Monitoring tail latencies.

sre-oncall: No infra alerts at the moment. Leaving watch for 30m. If not back to baseline we consider rolling back the full runtime rollout.

zoe: Drafted short customer blurb and posted to #ops-status: "Scheduled releases paused in EU-West while engineers investigate elevated request errors. We'll update within 30 minutes."

ian: Deploybot created tentative slot 2026-05-12T23:30Z (micro-stagger 3m). Backfill policy: emergency hotfixes and docs only.

kevin: Adding trace links and a short how-to for reverting the canary patch if needed.

sre-oncall: Monitoring hooks in place. No new alarms.

zoe: Owner recap: ian = pin & tentative slot; kevin = canary patch & traces; sre-oncall = infra watch; zoe = customer comms. Reconvene here in 25m.
